scope_rules: Stable rows retain completed work; mode/resource subrows are added with an explicit reason.
Equivalent wrappers may use one implementation only after their actual schema and semantics match; retain each binding check.
For pure readers/preparation, scientific combination can be marked not applicable with a specific explanation; native numerical facts still require readers.
An excluded operation remains in the source inventory with its reason. Literature graders remain separate.
A source-present program or service is not a bound or verified resource.
